description: a lean young woman with long brown hair in a loose braid down the back in a green and gold hood crowned with small deer antlers, a jerkin of overlapping green leaves and bark, a moss-green cloak hanging behind, leather bracers and soft leather boots, a curved bow carved from pale antler strapped upright on the back behind the shoulder beside a quiver of green-fletched arrows, the whole bow above the waist and behind the body, never in front of the legs, nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right so the belt buckle is at the right edge of the body, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body, the far arm hidden behind the body, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
